reviews.comment:
Valoración positiva la atención de los playeros buena, no tiene el plus que debería para ser una ACA, donde se atiende a socios de todo el país y turistas. El mini shop muy bien, un lugar lindo para compartir un momento con amigos. A una cuadra de la peatonal. Precios medios. Valoración negativa, las veces que fui el baño no estaba en condiciones, puede ser justo en ese momento no quiero dar por hecho que sea siempre así. Mayormente todo en condiciones.

(Translated by Google)
Positive feedback: the service from the attendants was good, but it doesn't have the extra touch it should have for an ACA (Automobile Club of Argentina) station, which serves members from all over the country and tourists. The mini-shop is very good, a nice place to spend time with friends. It's one block from the pedestrian area. Prices are average. Negative feedback: the times I went, the restroom wasn't in good condition. It might have been a one-off, so I don't want to assume it's always like that. For the most part, everything was fine.
